author: human
request:
Bug report: opening /owners?page=0 — or any page value below 1 — renders the
error page instead of the owner list. Expected behavior: the owner listing
treats any page value below 1 as the first page and responds with the normal
listing (HTTP 200). Find the cause, fix it, and cover the fix with a test.

author: product-requirements-expert
title: Owner listing treats a page below 1 as the first page
summary: Opening the owner listing with page 0 or a negative page shows the first page of owners as a normal listing (HTTP 200), instead of the error page.
acceptance_criteria: [REQ-OWN-005] given a request for owner listing page 0 or a negative page, when the listing opens, then the first page of owners is listed with HTTP 200, not the error page.
[REQ-OWN-005] given a request for a listing page below 1, when the listing is shown, then it marks the first page as the current page.
non_goals: A page beyond the last page of the owner listing: the intake does not mention it; behavior stays as today.
A page value that is not a number: the intake does not mention it; behavior stays as today.
Paging of the veterinarian directory (REQ-VET-001): the intake names only the owner listing.
notes: Owner statement source: intake-decision line 1 ("the owner listing treats any page value below 1 as the first page and responds with the normal listing (HTTP 200)"). Bug report, one behavior, code surface. PRD: added REQ-OWN-005 narrative sentence, two Done-when bullets, Owner records edge case 4. The test is one data-driven test whose rows are page 0 and a negative page (e.g. -1), each asserting HTTP 200, the owner list view, and current page 1. No Non-Goals row touched; no ubiquitous-language change needed. Autofix audit: no prd-autofix records.

author: system-design-expert
architectural_fit: The existing paged owner search in OwnerController (system-design.md § Contracts, OwnerController row) handles the slice. The one change: the handler normalizes the bound page parameter to at least 1 before the repository query and before the pagination model's current page is set. architecture-principles.md § Building Blocks, Web controller row, makes this binding, not a business rule, so it belongs in the controller and nowhere below it. Probable cause, found by grep (no IDE oracle connected, so this is the weaker basis): processFindForm passes page straight to findPaginatedForOwnersLastName, which builds a page request from page - 1. A zero-based index below 0 throws, and the error page renders. The design-doc edit: the OwnerController Contracts row gains the normalization clause and REQ-OWN-005.
integration_points: Framework transport: MockMvc in the existing @WebMvcTest(OwnerController.class) suite drives the real binding of the page query parameter (CLAUDE.md Testing Strategy, the sanctioned mock).

OwnerRepository boundary: reuse the suite's existing @MockitoBean OwnerRepository fixture. The suite already stubs findByLastNameStartingWith for the listing tests, a slice-local real repository would mean a JPA test that cannot exercise the controller clamp, and testing-principles.md (web-level rule) puts this test at the web level. Stub the search to return a multi-owner page so the list view renders. Verify the repository receives the first page (index 0) for page 0 and for -1.
Binding: no new entry point. page stays a bound int request parameter on the existing GET /owners handler; no persisted type is newly bound.

patterns.description: processFindForm: the existing listing handler. Normalize page at its top so that the query and addPaginationModel both see the normalized value.
Web controller row: normalizing a request parameter to its permitted range is binding.

risks.risk: The page is normalized for the query but not for the model, so currentPage renders as 0 or a negative number (fails the second Done-when bullet).
risks.mitigation: Normalize once, at the top of the handler, and use only the normalized value afterwards (architecture-principles.md Web controller row).

risks.risk: The owner listing path scales with the number of owners. system-design.md has no § Scale and Load section, so no row exists to cite.
risks.mitigation: The slice adds no path that scales with data and does not change the existing paged query. The size is unrecorded and treated as bounded, so the simplest readable form applies (a lower-bound clamp). The missing section is a durable-memory gap for a later slice that adds a data-scaling path.

notes: Autofix audit: the log has no design-doc-autofix records. The PRD non-goals (a page past the last page, a page that is not a number, vet-directory paging) stay untouched: do not clamp the upper bound and do not change VetController. Test: one data-driven test, processFindFormWithPageZeroOrNegativeListsFirstPage, with rows 0 and -1. Each row asserts HTTP 200, the owners/ownersList view, and currentPage 1.

findings.description: The literal 5 copies the production page size (OwnerController.java:135 `int pageSize = 5;`). That is hidden coupling: a page-size change breaks this test though the clamp is unaffected. The Pageable arg carries the zero-based index that matters here.
findings.fix: Capture-free alternative: stub with an answer or ArgumentMatchers that checks only pageable.getPageNumber() == 0 (e.g. argThat), or derive the size from the behavior rather than repeating 5.

author: security-reviewer
approved_aspects: Input handling: the request-supplied `page` stays bound as a primitive int (`@RequestParam(name = "page", defaultValue = "1") int requestedPage`, OwnerController.java:95); a non-numeric value still fails type conversion before the handler runs, so the slice adds no new input shape

Clamp is fail-secure: `int page = Math.max(requestedPage, 1);` (OwnerController.java:97) runs before both sinks, so PageRequest.of(page - 1, pageSize) (OwnerController.java:133) never gets a negative index, and a value below 1 no longer reaches the error page that renders exception messages (the security-principles.md:37 concern). Integer.MIN_VALUE also clamps to 1, with no overflow, because Math.max does no arithmetic
Rendered value: `currentPage` is now always the clamped int >= 1 (OwnerController.java:120 `model.addAttribute("currentPage", page);`); no request-derived text reaches the template

No removed or weakened check: the diff leaves the `setDisallowedFields("id", "*.id")` binder (OwnerController.java:61) and the `@Valid` paths alone, and adds no new binding target, sink, shell, file, or deserialization use (read from the full diff via scripts/changeset.py)
No secrets in the diff: the four changed hunks (prd.md, system-design.md, OwnerController.java, OwnerControllerTests.java) add only doc prose, the clamp, and a parameterized MockMvc test

Supply chain: the diff does not touch build.gradle (`git diff --stat -- build.gradle` empty); `dependencyCheckAnalyze` is not configured (`grep -n -i dependencyCheck build.gradle` found nothing), so this review ran no NVD match; resolved runtime versions are spring-webmvc 7.0.9 and tools.jackson.core:jackson-databind 3.1.5 (from `./gradlew dependencies --configuration runtimeClasspath`)
